atoms.title: The Organ
atoms.b: The organ is a keyboard instrument. It is made up of pipes that are played using keys. When you press a key, air is sent from the wind chest through the pipes, creating a tone.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-organ-3</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The organ is a keyboard instrument. It is made up of pipes that are played using keys. When you press a key, air is sent from the wind chest through the pipes, creating a tone.

instruction.text: What does an organ look like?

atoms.b: There are small, transportable organs and huge ones as large as a house. Large organs are usually found in churches and cathedrals.
Just like with a piano, the keys further to the left play lower notes, and the ones to the right play higher notes.

In contrast to a piano, organs have more than one keyboard. The keyboard you play with your hands is called the manual. The keyboard you play with your feet is called the pedalboard. Organs often have two manuals and one pedalboard.
